name: O.R. Tambo International Airport

hours.v: aerodrome operator, ATS, fuelling and handling all 24 hours

noise.v: no runway intersection take-offs 2000-0400; no engine run-ups 2000-0400 without the airport manager's prior permission (except emergency) (times as printed in the AIP)
noise.quote: No RWY intersection take-off BTN 2000 to 0400.

permits.v: foreign aircraft flying non-scheduled for hire need a Foreign Operators Permit, unless carrying up to 8 passengers or less than 1,000 kg of cargo or mail (those still need overflight and landing clearance from the Department of Transport). Business, private and other listed flights are exempt and apply for a landing clearance; general flights apply 3 working days before the flight
permits.quote: up to 8 passengers or less than 1000KG do not require a foreign operators permit ... The following flights are exempt from obtaining foreign operators permits and should apply for a landing clearance
